lines.text: Lesson five, you deluded fortune tellers.
lines.say: Lesson FIVE, you deluded fortune tellers!

lines.text: A soothsayer told me the exact day I'd die. Beware the Ides of March.
I had the date. And I still got stabbed.
And you think you know when the market will crash?
You don't even have a date, you fucking idiot.
The best days often come right after the worst ones.
Miss a handful, and your gains can get cut in half.
